thread:
ana: Quick sync — thinking about adding a 'micro-slice' view to the cost dashboard to attribute cache savings to per-route warm starts (not just per-tenant). Sketch: stacked sparkline with prefetch credits, kv-cache hits credited, and a marginal_token_cost line.
kevin: Do we have the telemetry to split prefetched vs hotpath KV hits? I thought logs only record cache_hit=true without source.
nana: We currently tag `cache_source` in the batcher logs for a sampled set of requests (~10%). We could temporarily increase sampling to 100% for a short probe window, and/or backfill from batcher debug traces.
jess: UX question — if we show prefetch credits as a negative cost, finance worried invoices will look weird. Can we show it as a separate 'savings' column with a tooltip instead of negative numbers?
rahul: Operational concern: full-sample telemetry will spike logging egress. Kevin, can you estimate? Also note: sticky routing for canaries reduces cache hit overlap, so per-route attribution needs to be canary-aware.
kevin: I'll run a staging probe today. Quick estimate: full sampling for 30m in staging -> ~120MB/min compressed to our log sink (~3.6GB). We should write probes to staging-only storage to avoid prod egress. Implementation option: do offline attribution job that joins session_affinity keys + cache_lineage instead of doing realtime joins. Cheaper and deterministic.
nana: Agreed. Proposal: default dashboard shows 'net cost' (token cost minus savings) and a toggle to expand to the breakdown (prefetch_savings, hotpath_savings, raw_token_cost). Implementation plan: (1) increase sampling for 30m in staging and run probe, (2) create offline join job to compute per-route attributions by session, (3) provide a small realtime estimator for recent 5m data. I'll open a PR for the offline job and a UX ticket for the toggle.
jess: :thumbsup: Add wording for billing docs: "Savings are estimates based on sampled telemetry; invoices reflect gross token charges minus credits as per contract." Also flag compliance — do not log prompt contents; only send prompt_hash and metadata.
costbot: Heads-up: changing sampling may bump quota alerts. Watch quota-alerts channel during the probe.
kevin: Probe script: ```bash
# staging probe
python infra/probes/cache_sampling_probe.py --duration 1800 --sample-rate 1.0 --out staging-bucket/prefetch-probe
```
kevin: I'll post results in this thread once done.
